review.imagery: Seventeen project renders were visually reviewed. The published 1982-pixel landscape project cover supplies the card and hero, replacing a portrait crop that cut the tower roof on desktop. Twelve native brochure scenes cover frontage, three arrival/lobby views, living room, dining, bedroom, bathroom, pool deck, loungers, outdoor fitness and children’s recreation. Four distinct current-gallery views add two interiors, amenity aerial and bedroom aerial. Duplicate exterior/pool/bedroom scenes, colored backgrounds and generic people photographs are excluded. No dated construction photographs or card badges.
review.floorPlans: Seventeen home drawings and the complete paired floorplate spread retain source keys and notices. Numerical unit areas are absent. Fact-sheet starting sizes describe broad categories and are not assigned to individual drawings. Confirm the contractual area and unit-specific configuration with SAMANA. All 18 complete physical pages 30–47 were individually reviewed. The 17 home drawings distinguish seven studio types, four one-bedroom/laundry types, two one-bedroom types, two two-bedroom types and two two-bedroom/store/laundry types. Each selected home sheet draws a private pool. Page 30 remains one complete spread containing two floorplates. No original notices, floor/unit keys or borders are removed.
review.location: Complete original brochure page 28 was visually reviewed, including all four time groups and ten destinations. The current page omits Fairgreen but agrees on the other ranges. Its official q value 25.093312047870818, 55.38483218650657 is retained with source hash and six-place conversion. The pin remains project vicinity. Highway references describe regional access, without an invented direct driveway connection.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML, original developer brochure and fact sheet retain receipts, original bytes and SHA-256 values. Native image origins and whole-sheet physical PDF links remain available. Protected ownership, commercial/text research and previously qualified source differences are preserved.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical unit areas, a verified visitor entrance, final approved unit fitout and dated construction photographs were not established.
